title: Notice Credit and Same-Day Surcharge on Rate Lock Commitment Extensions
content:
**Rate Lock Commitment extension rate: notice.** How early the borrower asked for the extension changes the per-day cost of the extension, in basis points. The adjusted per-day cost is never taken below zero. The notice is the calendar days from the request date of the lock's latest extension request, in the lock request log, to the lock's current expiration date.

**Rule.**

- When the latest extension request was logged at least **7** days (the early-notice days) before the lock's current expiration date, the early-notice credit of **0.25** basis points is subtracted.
- When it was logged on the current expiration date itself or later, the same-day surcharge of **0.5** basis points is added.
- Otherwise no notice adjustment applies.

| Latest extension request logged | Notice adjustment (basis points) |
|---|---|
| 7 or more days before the current expiration date | 0.25 subtracted |
| 1 to 6 days before the current expiration date | none |
| On the current expiration date itself or later | 0.5 added |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical, current expiration date 20 June)

- Request logged 13 June: 7 days of notice. The credit applies.
- Request logged 14 June: 6 days of notice. No adjustment.
- Request logged 19 June: 1 day of notice. No adjustment.
- Request logged 20 June: the surcharge applies.
